name: CSIR Senior Research Associateship (Scientists' Pool Scheme)
funder: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), Government of India
amount: Basic pay Rs 21,000-25,810/month (set by selection board) + DA and HRA as for CSIR staff + Rs 20,000/year contingency
other_rules: Indian scientists without regular employment in India, mainly those returning from abroad
natural-science PhDs need 2 years of postdoc or teaching experience (fresh PhD allowed in pharma, veterinary and engineering)
medical candidates need MD/MS/MDS plus 2 years of residency or research
minimum marks and SCI publications required
notes: Stopgap placement while looking for a permanent post, not a regular appointment. Interviews can be held in absentia for applicants still abroad. Selection takes up to 4 months. Pay figures from an ISTI summary (2021) and likely revised; confirm on csirhrdg.res.in.
